settings.heading: Privacy policy
settings.lead: How EchoByJMG collects and uses your personal data, and the rights you have.

settings.title: Data controller
settings.text: JM Group Limited, Suite F, 4th Floor, Yip Cheung Centre, 10 Fung Yip Street, Chai Wan, Hong Kong. Contact for data questions: hello@echobyjmg.com. [EU representative, if required: name and address.]

settings.title: What we collect
settings.text: Name, address, email and phone when you order. Order and payment history. Your email if you join the Cozy Club. How you use the site, if you accept cookies.

settings.title: Why, and on what legal basis
settings.text: To deliver your order (contract). To meet bookkeeping rules (legal obligation). To send the Cozy Club newsletter (consent). To improve the shop and our marketing (consent through cookies).

settings.title: Who we share it with
settings.text: Shopify (shop platform), payment providers, our Danish warehouse and carriers, our email platform and our review service. [Confirm the full list of processors.]

settings.title: How long we keep it
settings.text: Order data for 5 years after the end of the financial year, as Danish bookkeeping rules require. Newsletter data until you unsubscribe. [Confirm.]

settings.title: Your rights
settings.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, object to its use, and take it with you. Write to [email].

settings.title: Complaints
settings.text: You can complain to Datatilsynet, the Danish Data Protection Agency, at datatilsynet.dk.
